name: Feral Crown
body:
School enchantment (charm, compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level druid 5, ranger 4, shaman 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a crown made of bones, fangs, claws, or other animal parts)

EFFECT

Range self
Area 20 ft. radius centered on you
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and don the crown and for the duration of the spell, any animal that comes within the radius of the spell must make a Will save or be affected by the charm animal spell until this spell’s duration ends. Additionally, anytime during the spell, you can use a standard action to grant any charmed animal the effects of the rage spell until the beginning of your next turn.
